dashboard.load_failed: The statistics could not be loaded.
dashboard.analytics_disabled: Language statistics are switched off, so nothing new is being recorded. Anything below was collected before it was switched off.
dashboard.card_requests_help: Every page view counted in this period.
dashboard.card_visitors_help: A visitor is counted once per day, so somebody who returns on three days counts three times. This is not a count of people.
dashboard.card_languages_help: How many different languages visitors asked for. Page views that named no language are not counted here.
dashboard.card_countries_help: How many countries visitors were placed in. Addresses that could not be placed are not counted here.
dashboard.card_served_help: Page views that asked for a language this forum has installed.
dashboard.card_unserved_help: Page views that asked for a language this forum does not have. These are what the Missing tab is about.
dashboard.card_unstated_help: Page views whose browser named no usable language. They were neither served nor failed. Served, not served and no preference add up to the page-view total.
dashboard.languages_empty: Nothing has been recorded for this period yet.
dashboard.countries_empty: Nothing has been recorded for this period yet.
dashboard.missing_description: Languages visitors asked for that have no language pack installed, busiest first. Different spellings of the same language are listed once.
dashboard.missing_empty: Every language visitors asked for is installed.
dashboard.trend_empty: No page views were recorded in this period.

settings.detection_order_help: Which signal is tried first when working out a visitor's language.
settings.default_locale_help: Applied when nothing could be detected. Leave this on the forum default to keep Flarum's own behaviour.
settings.enable_analytics_help: Records daily aggregated counts of the languages and countries visitors ask for. No IP addresses, request headers or visitor identifiers are stored.
settings.ignore_bots_help: Keeps known bots and crawlers out of the statistics. Their language is still detected, it is just not counted.
settings.retention_days_help: Daily rows older than this are deleted automatically.

ip_data.notice: IP country lookup uses a dataset bundled with this extension, built on {date} from public regional internet registry data. Updating the extension refreshes it.
ip_data.notice_unavailable: The bundled IP dataset is missing, so IP country lookup is inactive and only browser language detection will be used.

cleanup.command_description: Delete language detection statistics older than the configured retention period.
cleanup.button_help: Deletes the rows older than the saved retention period. If you changed the period above, save it first. This cannot be undone.
cleanup.confirm: Delete every statistics row older than the retention period? This cannot be undone.
cleanup.retention_disabled: Statistics are set to never be deleted, so nothing was removed.
cleanup.deleted: Deleted {count} statistics rows older than {days} days.
cleanup.nothing_to_delete: No statistics were old enough to delete.
cleanup.failed: The old statistics could not be deleted.
